theme_and_archetype.description: Grounded, natural, matte, premium, and trustworthy. Tailored for an Indian ecommerce user base, focusing on warmth and cleanliness.

rules.anti_default: Never use Inter, Roboto, or standard defaults for headings.
rules.contrast: Ensure text contrast meets APCA minimums (4.5:1 for body).
rules.labels: Use overline style for category tags and badges.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Mobile-first, generous touch targets, breathable negative space. Use Tailwind padding scale.
spacing_and_layout.container: px-4 md:px-6 w-full max-w-md mx-auto relative min-h-screen pb-20 (to accommodate bottom tab)

surface_styles.headers: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 sticky top-0 z-50 border-b border-border/40
surface_styles.bottom_nav: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/90 fixed bottom-0 w-full max-w-md border-t border-border/40 pb-safe z-50
surface_styles.product_cards: bg-white border border-black/5 rounded-2xl shadow-sm overflow-hidden

component_instructions.global: This is a mobile web app. Limit max-width to mobile sizes (max-w-md mx-auto) to mimic a native app experience on desktop browsers. Include bottom tab navigation across main screens.
component_instructions.Splash: Solid primary green background (#2D5016). Large 'Bharat Pansari' wordmark in white Outfit font. Subtle leaf/sprout icon.
component_instructions.Onboarding: Swipeable carousel. Large earthy illustrations/images, h2 headings, and clear 'Next' / 'Get Started' rounded-full primary buttons.

Home.search_bar: Sticky top bar, pill-shaped input, soft shadow.
Home.hero_carousel: Horizontal scroll, generous padding, rounded-2xl images with gradient overlays and text.
Home.category_chips: Horizontal flex, hide scrollbar, pill-shaped with icon + text.
Home.product_sections: Sections for Featured, New Arrivals, Popular. 2-column grid or horizontal overflow list. Bold Section headers.

component_instructions.Categories: Grid layout (2 or 3 columns). Square cards with subtle background (section_alt), centered image, text below.
component_instructions.ProductListing: Sort/Filter sticky bar below header. 2-column grid. Product cards include image, brand, name, price, strike-through MRP, stock indicator, star rating, and a circular '+' Add to Cart button at bottom right.
component_instructions.ProductDetail: Immersive image gallery (aspect-square, max-h-[50vh]). Title, Price, Rating. 'Ingredients' and 'Description' in collapsible accordions (Shadcn). Fixed bottom bar for 'Add to Cart' & 'Wishlist' buttons.
component_instructions.Cart: List of items with quantity selectors (-/1/+). Coupon input with 'Apply' button. Fixed bottom section with total breakdown (Subtotal, Tax, Total) and large Checkout button.
component_instructions.Account: List group for navigation (Orders, Addresses, Settings, Privacy). Guest state shows Login/Register prompt. Use Shadcn Avatar.
component_instructions.BottomNav: Fixed bottom. 6 tabs (Home, Categories, Search, Wishlist, Cart, Account). Since 6 is dense, ensure icons are balanced and text is text-[10px] tracking-tight. Active tab uses primary green, inactive uses text-secondary.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the application as a mobile-first responsive web app (max-w-md mx-auto) wrapping standard React + Tailwind + Shadcn.
Implement bottom tab navigation utilizing React Router to switch between Home, Categories, Search, Wishlist, Cart, Account.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='add-to-cart-btn').
Use pure HTML/Tailwind for custom layouts like product grids and hero carousels; use heavily customized Shadcn for forms, accordions, tabs, and modals.
Do NOT use generic placeholders (like via.placeholder.com). Use the URLs provided in media_urls.
Apply the font families 'Outfit' (headings) and 'Manrope' (body) globally via CSS imports.
Stick rigidly to the defined color palette: #2D5016 as the primary functional color. Limit its use strictly to CTAs and active states.
